plain_english: O consciousness-dense one — therefore you indeed are supreme; in you indeed the universes shine at once. And they flash forth by the power of your glory; you indeed are also their supreme-Lord maker.
sanskrit_cite: saṃvidghanas tena parastvam eva tvayyeva viśvāni cakāsati drāk | sphuranti ca tvanmahasaḥ prabhāvāt tvam eva caiṣāṃ parameśakartā
